answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the oasis checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The glacier graph is rebuilt each epoch, thus the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the falcon audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 3 times its size, so a group of 70 keys loses far more than 70 single identities would. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
